items.exampleEn: Our school's rank went up to third this year.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的排名今年升到第三。

items.exampleEn: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
Moving to a new city takes considerable effort.
items.exampleZh: 搬到新城市需要相當大的努力。

items.exampleEn: The machine calculates the price for you.
items.exampleZh: 這台機器會幫你算好價格。

items.exampleEn: A large proportion of our customers are students.
items.exampleZh: 我們的顧客有很大比例是學生。

items.exampleEn: We don't have sufficient time to finish today.
items.exampleZh: 我們今天沒有足夠的時間完成。

items.exampleEn: This plan is outside the scope of our team.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫超出我們團隊負責的範圍。

items.sentenceEn: Please calculate the total before you pay.

items.audioEn: A bunch of bananas costs only one dollar at this market.
items.audioZh: 在這個市場，一串香蕉只要一美元。
items.questionZh: 在這個市場，一串香蕉多少錢？

items.sentenceEn: Is one week sufficient for this job?
items.sentenceZh: 一個星期夠做這份工作嗎？

items.sentenceEn: My new job gives me more scope to use my English.
items.sentenceZh: 我的新工作讓我有更多發揮英文的空間。

items.stemEn: A large ____ of the money was spent on rent.
items.stemZh: 這筆錢有很大一部分花在房租上。

items.stemEn: Two eggs are ____ for this cake; you don't need more.
items.stemZh: 這個蛋糕兩顆蛋就夠了，不需要更多。

items.passageEn: This year, our manager wanted to calculate how many hours each team worked. She found that a large proportion of the work was done by one small team of five people. Much of their work was outside the normal scope of their jobs, but they did it anyway. The manager gave each of them a bunch of flowers and a considerable bonus. One of them also moved up in rank. Was the bonus sufficient? "More than enough!" they said.
items.passageZh: 今年，我們經理想計算每個團隊工作了多少小時。她發現有很大比例的工作是一個五人小組完成的。他們的很多工作超出了平常的職務範圍，但他們還是做了。經理給了每人一束花和一筆可觀的獎金。其中一人還升了職。獎金夠嗎？「綽綽有餘！」他們說。

options: 很多工作是五人小組做的
每個團隊的人數都實在太少

questions.questionZh: 經理給了那個小組什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們沒有足夠的錢買新車。
referenceEn: We don't have sufficient money to buy a new car.
We do not have sufficient money for a new car.
rubricZh: sufficient 表示「足夠的」，放在名詞前（例如 sufficient money）
例如用 to＋原形動詞、for＋名詞等說明用途
寫 enough money 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 科學家算出了這顆星星離地球有多遠。
referenceEn: Scientists have calculated how far this star is from the earth.
Scientists calculated how far the star is from the earth.
rubricZh: 用 calculate 表示「計算」（例如 calculated how far…）
時態可用 calculated、have calculated 等
